rationales: Metals contain mobile, delocalized electrons that can move through the solid.
Non-metals generally do not have free mobile electrons.
Ionic compounds have ions, but their ions are usually fixed in place in the solid state.
Covalent compounds generally do not contain free mobile electrons.
CO is the formula for carbon monoxide, not an element in group 11.
Nickel (Ni) belongs to group 10.
Copper (Cu) belongs to group 11.
Zinc (Zn) belongs to group 12.
This value is approximately the mass of a proton, not an electron.
This is not the accepted mass of an electron.
This is not the accepted mass of an electron.
The electron’s mass is approximately 9.11 × 10⁻²⁸ g, so this is the closest listed value.
Ernest Rutherford is widely known as the father of nuclear science.
Bohr developed a model of the atom but is not known by this title.
Thomson discovered the electron and proposed an atomic model.
Crookes studied cathode rays but is not known by this title.
Cl⁻ is a negatively charged ion, not a neutral free radical.
H⁺ is a positively charged ion, not a free radical.
A chlorine atom has an unpaired electron and is a free radical.
Cl₂ is a stable molecule with paired electrons, not a free radical.
Hydrogen has oxidation number −1 in metal hydrides.
The oxidation number of hydrogen in metal hydrides is not −2.
The oxidation number of hydrogen in metal hydrides is not −3.
The oxidation number of hydrogen in metal hydrides is not −4.
Atomic number 56 is barium, which precedes the lanthanide series.
Lanthanum, with atomic number 57, starts the lanthanide series in this classification.
Atomic number 58 is cerium, which follows lanthanum.
Atomic number 59 is praseodymium, which follows lanthanum and cerium.
Hexane has the lowest boiling point of these alkanes and evaporates most readily.
Octane has a higher boiling point than hexane.
Decane has a higher boiling point than octane.
Dodecane has the highest boiling point among these options.
Methane is a molecular compound, not a hard covalent-network solid.
Carbon dioxide is a molecular compound, not a hard covalent-network solid.
Sulfuric acid is a molecular liquid, not a hard covalent-network solid.
Glucose forms molecular crystals, but it is not a hard covalent-network solid; none of the choices clearly satisfies the description.
Dental amalgam is not a gas-gas solution.
Dental amalgam is not a liquid-liquid solution.
Dental amalgam is classified as a liquid-in-solid solution, with mercury mixed into solid metals.
Dental amalgam is not classified as a solid-solid solution.
Hydrogen is oxidized and oxygen is reduced when water forms, so the reaction is redox.
The reaction is not an acid-base reaction.
No acid and base react to form salt and water in this formation reaction.
Water forms by combining hydrogen and oxygen, not by decomposing a compound.
Fluorine’s electronegativity is not 1.0 on the commonly used school scale.
Fluorine’s electronegativity is not 2.0.
Fluorine’s electronegativity is not 3.0.

Mass-by-volume percentage requires the mass of the alcohol and solution volume.
A volume of alcohol dissolved in a given mass of water is expressed as volume-by-mass percentage.
Volume-by-volume percentage requires the volume of the solution, rather than the mass of water.
Mist consists of liquid droplets dispersed in a gas.
Mist is not solid particles dispersed in a gas; that describes smoke or dust.
Mist is not gas dispersed in a liquid.
Mist is not gas dispersed in a solid.

Methane is essentially insoluble in water.
Sodium chloride dissolves readily in water.
Benzene is nonpolar and is not water-soluble.
